title: Poll Picks Up New Arrivals
description: There's no notification WebSocket in SwiftCargo (unlike tracking) — the bell relies on a plain 5-second poll instead. Confirm a new notification actually shows up on its own, without any manual reload, within that window.
successCondition: With the notification dropdown closed and no interaction from the user, triggering a new notifying event (e.g. booking a shipment) results in the header's unread count badge updating to reflect the new notification within roughly 5-10 seconds (covering the POLL_MS interval plus the async delivery delay), with no page reload or manual re-fetch performed by the test.
hints: The bell polls every 5000ms (POLL_MS in NotificationBell.tsx) regardless of whether the dropdown is open — you don't need to open it for the badge to update.
Budget for both the polling interval and the notification queue's own ~500ms delivery delay when deciding how long to wait before asserting.
